gap/service: City trees: inspection, limbs down, trees down, stumps
prior evidence: Observed: public saved searches were previously partial/open or sampled. Retrieval across 27 forestry Work Order searches returned 34,739 saved-search memberships, deduplicating to 27,267 work orders: 16,778 non-CLOSED and 10,489 CLOSED.
relevant QE layers: 63,64,75,89-109,124-127 Work Order layers; 66 Inspection; 67-69 Service Request layers
what schema supports: Returned work orders narrow the tree-trimming completion-source gap. Through 2026-10-13, the CLOSED union has 5,961 calendar-valid 2025-26 ActualFinishDate values; 94 non-CLOSED records also have finish dates, including 32 in the current window. Across the union, 1,750 finishes precede initiation, including 565 current-window dates. In a separate R1 cohort of 572 converted tree requests, compatible-operation and address/30m matching found 105 candidates and 89 chronology-valid finish candidates, 74 at exact address. All 89 are trim work; 6 finish by promise, 83 later, median 218 days late. No RequestIds were returned.
key unknown: Direct 311 linkage and ActualFinishDate semantics remain open. No general closed all-city removal layer was found, so removal and stump completion gaps remain; absence from open searches is not proof of completion. The R1 572 cohort differs from the 565-count N2 matrix basis and must not be combined.
priority: P2; rank 14 of 25; trimming source gap narrowed, removal/stump unresolved
affected count/date/basis: 565 hand-off/converted closures in N2; filed 2025-01-02..2026-10-06; denominator 61,845. Separate R1 converted cohort: 89/572 chronology-valid finish candidates; definitions differ.

key unknown: No direct request-to-work-order key was returned. Address/spatial matches are candidates and can collide with unrelated work at the same site; absence of a match does not mean the sidewalk was not repaired.
